entities.summary: Radivoje Brajović was the President of the Presidency of the Socialist Republic of Montenegro from May 1986 to May 1988 and the President of its Executive Council in 1982–1986. He was a member of the League of Communists of Montenegro and the League of Communists of Yugoslavia.

entities.summary: Radivoje Brajović was the President of the Presidency of the Socialist Republic of Montenegro from May 1986 to May 1988 and the President of its Executive Council in 1982–1986. He was a member of the League of Communists of Montenegro and the League of Communists of Yugoslavia.
